note: Each dinosaur is a fixed ideal profile on the four trait axes, -5 to +5.

dinosaurs.name: Tyrannosaurus rex
dinosaurs.blurb: You're the apex alpha guy that takes charge. Always direct and honest

dinosaurs.name: Velociraptor
dinosaurs.blurb: A fast and sharp thinker movin around with a small pack

dinosaurs.name: Triceratops
dinosaurs.blurb: Always grounded and calm in face of any adversity. Reliable guy

dinosaurs.name: Ankylosaurus
dinosaurs.tagline: Like a cooler triceratops with a tail and homies
dinosaurs.blurb: You are almost as solid as a triceratops but way more social and cool because of that.

dinosaurs.name: Parasaurolophus
dinosaurs.blurb: You have the maternal instinct to keep people safe and grouped together. Bestest friend and listener

dinosaurs.name: Spinosaurus
dinosaurs.blurb: You're so big and scary but not really combative. Also a very interesting looking dino

dinosaurs.name: Pteranodon
dinosaurs.blurb: You're a live in the moment type guy and probably own a free spirit mug.

dinosaurs.name: Therizinosaurus
dinosaurs.blurb: You'll default to de-escalating situations but will unleash the Cretacious period on em if asked for it'

dinosaurs.name: Pachycephalosaurus
dinosaurs.blurb: big brute forcer. you just do stuff you think would work and that works

dinosaurs.name: Dilophosaurus
dinosaurs.blurb: Lots of potential that you choose to keep hidden. A bit of a loner but not antisocial
